fact: At Cairo ICT'24 (opening 17 November 2024) the ICT Minister reported to the Prime Minister, under the Digital Egypt strategy, 8 million registrants on the Digital Egypt platform, 23 Digital Egypt innovation centres built in 19 governorates against a target of 32 in 27 governorates, and about 400,000 trainees against a 500,000 target for the current fiscal year.
title: رئيس الوزراء يشهد افتتاح معرض ومؤتمر Cairo ICT'24
